description:
Every episode is one subject, told start to finish in a calm, steady voice over slow visuals. The scale of the universe from a quark to the observable edge. The first hour after the asteroid. Deep time, extinct worlds, the physics of very large numbers. Two hours or more, no music, no sudden sounds, and nothing that jolts you awake at three in the morning.

Everything here is real science with real sources, written to be interesting enough to hold you and quiet enough to let go of.

Good for falling asleep, insomnia, background listening, studying, or any night your mind needs somewhere very far away to go.

New documentary for sleep every few days.
